test_timestamp_integer_conversion: test the TimestampTest class to verify integer conversion between nanoseconds, seconds, milliseconds, and microseconds
test_timestamp_json: test the TimestampTest class to verify JSON string serialization and deserialization of protobuf Timestamp messages
test_timestamp_datetime: test the TimestampTest class to verify conversion between protobuf Timestamp and Python datetime objects
test_timestamp_sub_annotation: test the TimestampTest class to verify subtraction operations between Timestamp, datetime, and timedelta objects
test_timestamp_add_annotation: test the TimestampTest class to verify addition operations between Timestamp, timedelta, and Duration objects
